passageSupersessions.before: The read session for installation readers (law 458c r5 item 8). It keeps a complete I that the observation session admitted: the held fence, the retained chain, the account and the read receipt, with the observation session's one ledger. Every later capture and recheck is charged to that ledger before it runs (item 6). A capture opens prefixes and a leaf only through the retained I and its retained descendants: each directory judged private by the owner's predicate on a charged capture and named exactly, the file judged a private regular file, bounded, named, on H's filesystem, read, judged again and reopened by name. Its failures are values, so the full recheck (item 5 step 4) runs after every capture, over the fence, the observation's required files and every file captured since; any refusal latches the session. Between full rechecks, the held-fence check samples the carrier's name and identity, and a capture's own recheck samples its edges and file. It lends the trust readers a held-fence view and charges their retained budget to the same ledger. Captures never walk from the root again; admit_project_root alone walks from / to the launch or explicit path and the selected project root (law X2 r5, unit X2b-1), charged on the session ledger. Each of the session's admissions runs on its ledger under the held fence, then one full recheck, and any refusal latches it: store_endpoint admits the selected store endpoint from the observation's one read against the read receipt's selected core, reading no file (law X3a items 1 and 2, unit X3a-1); admit_project_root selects and admits the root with its registry classification and rechecks it; observe_project_tracking observes the root's Git tracking, reading the process environment only to refuse and the fixed system sources as refusal-only evidence (law X2 r7 item 6a, unit X2b-2); and admit_namespace makes the session the namespace fence holder for an Eligible root, for a SHARED-READ lease only (law X2 item 7, unit X2d). Never a write capability.

passageSupersessions.before: The ordinary writer's admission (law X1 r1 items 2 to 7). A writer that is not a creator produces the write receipt (the same producer composition as the read side's, typed Write), rechecks it, enters the law 468 durable write gate with the receipt's sealed DurableBarrierQualification as the gate's only input, and rechecks the receipt again while the gate's fence is held; a failed second recheck releases the fence and returns nothing. OrdinaryWriteAdmission holds the admitted DurableInstallation (the held fence and confirmed durability), the write receipt and the gate that admitted it, kept for its one ledger; it has no serialized form and no conversion into a read session. An absent I is INSTALLATION.NOT_INITIALIZED through the gate's positive absence; I is never created. The admission's refusals are their law 468 item 6 rows through 468c's maps. Further standing comes only through its steps, each under the held fence and followed by the gate's full recheck and the receipt's recheck, any refusal spending the gate: admit_store_endpoint validates the selected store endpoint from the gate's one read against the receipt's selected core and yields StoreAdmittedWriter, which grants only the endpoint (law X3a items 1 and 2, unit X3a-1; a refusal releases the fence); admit_project_root, observe_project_tracking, register_first_use and recheck_registered run on the gate's ledger with the write receipt's premise (law X2 items 2 to 6a, unit X2c); admit_namespace makes the writer the namespace fence holder for an APPEND-WRITE or EXCLUSIVE lease (law X2 item 7, unit X2d); and begin_operation consumes the writer into the checked operation handoff, taking the floor publication's TrustInvocation and carrying X4's live guard (law X2 r8 item 7a, unit X2e; law X4 r7, unit X4a). For the handoff it lends, crate-internally, join_store_endpoint, attempt_step on the write receipt's attempt ledger, gate_step on the gate's own ledger at the lease-free point (the installation lent mutably so a confirmed trust publication can advance state.v1, and the receipt's bootstrap source for the fenced first read's F-absent branch, law X4B r5 item 2, unit X4B-b), selected_closure and into_parts. Library only: no command is wired.

passageSupersessions.before: Produce the read side's premise receipt (law 458c r5 items 1 to 4): the process's one attempt, the actor, InitialCore and InitialPlatform, exactly the creator's producers, with no intent, storage choice, disclosure, effect or fence. Law X1 r1 items 1 and 2 type it by purpose: the one producer composition makes PlatformReceipt<Read> (ReadPremiseReceipt, produce_read_platform) or PlatformReceipt<Write> (WritePlatformReceipt, produce_write_platform); Read and Write are sealed, neither receipt converts into the other, and a receipt whose actor, core or platform belongs to another attempt is the invariant row. The read receipt is private and not Clone, holds its own attempt, and lends only the sealed ReadPremiseQualification that InitialPlatform alone implements: the check that a filesystem is H's and the omission premise with 465 item 4's scope, no barrier policy. The write receipt is likewise private, not Clone and holds its own attempt; its lending is the durable write gate's sealed DurableBarrierQualification, beside which it lends the running core's embedded bootstrap source to the fenced first read alone (law X4B r5 item 2, unit X4B-b), charge, one charged step on its attempt ledger with that lending (unit X2e), charge_guarded, the same step with the actor, core and platform rechecks lent beside it for the checkpoint's guard (law X4 r7 item 4, unit X4a), and the attempt ledger's one end-path settlement reserve and its single spend, on the commit session's way only (law X3d r6 item 8, unit X3d-1). Both purposes expose recheck, the actor, core and platform rechecks on the receipt's own attempt, and selected_core, the selected core's closure and state writer K as values only (law X3a item 1). Both also expose core_evaluator_closure, the selected core's evaluator closure (contract successor EC1) derived from the same authenticated inventory, as a value only (law X3d r8 item 13, unit X3d-3), and, only under the joint predicate (test, crash-matrix or scenario-fixtures), the read of its preimages behind CommitSession's test-support accessor. Every refusal ends in its law 468 item 6 row through 468c's maps. InstallationReadFence::acquire and doctor's installation check pass it to the observation session. The ordinary writer's admission consumes the write receipt (law X1), and the operation handoff carries it (unit X2e). Its one wired CLI path is opensip doctor (law X10), through doctor's installation check; no CLI command reaches a write receipt.
